purpose: Compare current skill content, then independently use each ordinary bounded audit on full Agentic Mermaid main
source_copies: Independent full tracked copies including shallow 30-commit Git histories; no prior findings supplied
mode: ordinary bounded audit; no whole-subsystem retirement campaign
work: read-only audit, with disposable scratch-only fault/allowed-change probes; no product PR or production changes
common_scope: Entire public repository available. Let each workflow choose high-value candidates; disclose selected and actually inspected scope, unexecuted tiers, setup and tool failures. Findings need concrete source evidence. Separate product defects, test gaps, implementation locks and setup limitations. No minimum findings/deletion target.
common_output: Original report plus machine-readable findings and read/command ledgers retained before comparative verification. Credible fault and allowed-change experiments encouraged when feasible; incomplete leads labelled.
retries: No model trial retries or answer regeneration. Corrected technical commands retain original failure.
comparison: Descriptive overlap, unique findings, grounding, proof and restraint; no composite score or superiority estimate from one subject per skill. Previous historical project/skill exposure prevents treating this as an unseen benchmark.
runtime: Bun 1.4.4 matched to repo CI; Node v24.22.3; separate dependency installations and caches, shared host not enforced OS isolation. No live provider/model calls.
